messages:
maria: Evening check-in — quick async.

maria: What I did: pushed gateway PR for routing-policy v2 (refs #432) to staging, ran the e2e smoke.
Blockers: seeing intermittent 429s from dedicated pools on /api/generate when we get short bursts. Trace points to a mismatch between edge rate configuration and the internal token-bucket.
Today: will add a short-term override (canary) and open MR to tune burst_size + fallback policy. Will also ping for a quick CR.

devon: looking now, give me ~15. can you paste a snippet of the error?

maria: pasted logs below:
```
[2026-03-17T20:13:22Z] req=abc123 route=/api/generate resp=429 reason="rate_limited" bucket=rt-fast edge_header=X-Rate-Tier:standard
[2026-03-17T20:13:23Z] req=abc124 route=/api/generate resp=429 reason="token_bucket_exhausted" pool=dedicated-a
```

aj: fyi I bumped burst_size to 200 for a similar case last week and it smoothed short spikes. might help while we tune.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-17T21:00Z (canary).

tess: @maria if you change the rate-policy, remember to run loadgen with --seq=256 to warm KV cache and exercise long-context paths.

maria: good call, will include that in the test plan. also planning to add an extra log field: X-Req-Id + routing-variant so we can correlate edge vs internal throttle.

devon: quick question — could JWT rotation cause auth rejections that look like 429? just want to rule out.

maria: not in this trace — auth returns 200 and the gateway forwards fine. this is post-auth token-bucket behavior.

devon: ok. pls add a trace_id and I can attach a quick span in the agent to see rate checks. once you add the test and logs I can CR. :thumbsup:

aj: tagging @oncall-bot since this may show up in prod overnight; if it does, fallback policy should route to cheaper model variant instead of hard 429.

maria: will add fallback rule to the MR and include rollback steps. MR coming in ~30m.

devon: thanks — will review after your MR.

maria: TL;DR: staging 429s on bursts -> routing vs token-bucket mismatch. Plan: MR adds override + extra logs + test plan (loadgen seq 256) + fallback rule. Pinging @devon for CR, @tess for test checklist.

maria: any objections to a short canary ramp after deploy?

aj: nope, go for controlled canary and watch 429 rate.

devon: agree. will queue review.

maria: thanks all — posting MR link once ready.
